faq.q: What services does First Rehabilitation provide?
faq.a: We provide physical therapy, occupational therapy, certified hand therapy, and an exclusive on-site wellness and gym program — a full continuum of care under one roof.

We accept most major health insurance plans, including Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Humana, Tricare, workers' compensation, and self-pay. Call our front desk and we'll gladly verify your specific coverage.

faq.q: Do I need a referral to start therapy?
faq.a: It depends on your insurance plan. Many patients can begin under Florida's direct access provisions, while some plans require a physician referral. Call us and we'll walk you through exactly what your plan needs.

faq.q: What should I expect at my first visit?
faq.a: Your initial visit includes a movement-based evaluation, a discussion of your activity goals, and a proposed plan of care that may include hands-on treatment and home exercises starting day one.

faq.q: How do I schedule an appointment?
faq.a: Call us at 561-624-4263 or use the contact page to request an appointment — our team will follow up promptly to find a time that works.

faq.q: What should I wear to my appointments?
faq.a: Comfortable clothing you can move in. For lower-body conditions, shorts or loose pants are ideal; for shoulder or arm conditions, a shirt that allows easy access to the area being treated.

Certified Hand Therapists (CHTs) complete thousands of hours of specialized training in rehabilitation of the hand, wrist, and upper extremity. Our program, led by Laura Drumm, CHT, includes custom splinting fabricated in-clinic.

Our on-site wellness and gym program lets patients continue training after discharge from therapy — with personal training, group classes, and senior functional fitness guided by a team that knows your history.

faq.q: Do your therapists work together on my care?
faq.a: Yes. When appropriate, our PTs, OTs, and hand therapist coordinate assessments and treatment plans so your recovery reflects a genuine team-based approach.
